Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for KAU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for KAU Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Assistant Professor post at Kerala Agricultural University is scheduled for 23rd September 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MSc in Horticulture with a minimum of 55% marks. NET qualification is preferred, and a PhD in Floriculture and Landscaping is also considered advantageous.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this KAU recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Assistant Professor post is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per prevailing government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will be offered a salary of Rs. 1470 per day for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this KAU Assistant Professor job?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview with all required documents on the specified date.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry original documents and self-attested photocopies of your ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Assistant Professor (Floriculture and Landscaping) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the KAU office. The specific address and reporting time will be detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position. The duration of the contract will be as per the terms and conditions mentioned in the official notification.
